name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme
des: The AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme is a flagship initiative by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India, exclusively for girl students pursuing technical education in AICTE-approved institutions. The scheme's tagline is 'Empowering Women through Technical Education'. It provides ₹50,000 per annum to meritorious girl students admitted to the 1st year of AICTE-approved Degree (UG/PG) or Diploma technical courses — this includes MBA, as MBA is a technical degree course approved by AICTE. A total of 10,000 scholarships are awarded annually — 5,000 for Degree level and 5,000 for Diploma level — distributed across 23 States/UTs based on proportionate share of AICTE-approved seats; for remaining 13 States/UTs and North-Eastern states all eligible girl students automatically receive the scholarship. Applications are submitted through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) and the AICTE Pragati-Saksham portal. The deadline is typically October 31 each year. Amount is disbursed as a lump sum via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-linked bank account.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum as lump sum for every year of study (MBA: up to 2 years for 1st year admitted students)
For lateral entry (2nd year direct admission to MBA): up to 1 year
Amount usable for college fees, books, stationery, laptops, computers, software, and other educational equipment
No separate grants for hostel fees or medical expenses
5,000 Degree-level scholarships awarded annually across India
SC/ST/OBC reservation within the 5,000 quota: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC 27% as per GOI norms
For 13 UTs and North-Eastern states: all eligible girl applicants receive scholarship (no merit cutoff)
Scholarship renewable annually on successful promotion to next year — renewal via NSP with Promotion Certificate
Amount disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-linked bank account
criteria: Applicant must be a female Indian citizen (only girl students eligible)
Must be admitted to 1st year of a full-time AICTE-approved technical Degree programme — includes MBA, MCA, B.E./B.Tech, B.Pharm etc. — at an AICTE-approved institution
Lateral entry students admitted to 2nd year are also eligible
Admission must be through Centralised Admission Process (CAP) of State/Central Government — management quota admissions are NOT eligible
Annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 (for married applicants: income of parents or in-laws, whichever is higher)
Maximum 2 girl children per family can avail this scholarship
Institution must be AICTE-approved with valid AISHE code
Only full-time courses are eligible — part-time and distance courses are NOT eligible
Must not be receiving any other Central/State Government or AICTE-sponsored scholarship simultaneously — if already receiving any GOI scholarship, NOT eligible
If student fails or drops out in any subsequent year, she will NOT be eligible for further scholarship renewal
3rd year or later applicants are NOT eligible — only 1st year (or lateral entry 2nd year) fresh applicants
required_documents: Annual Income Certificate from competent government authority (family income ≤ ₹8 lakh)
Admission Letter issued by Directorate of Technical Education / CAP allotment proof for MBA
Previous qualifying exam Marksheet (Graduation marksheet for MBA applicants)
Fee Receipt for current academic year
Bank Passbook or Cancelled Cheque (Aadhaar-linked General Savings account — FRILL/Minor/Joint accounts NOT accepted)
Bonafide Certificate / Certificate from Principal/Director of MBA institute
Caste Certificate (if applicable — for SC 15% / ST 7.5% / OBC 27% reserved quota within Pragati)
For renewal: Promotion Certificate duly certified by Head of Institution
application_process: Visit the AICTE Pragati-Saksham portal: https://aicte-pragati-saksham-gov.in (primary portal — NOT scholarships.gov.in)
Click 'New Registration' and complete registration with Aadhaar number, mobile number, email ID, and bank details
After registration, login using Application ID and password received on registered mobile
Select 'AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girls' under Degree level
Fill in personal details, MBA course details, institution AISHE code, family income details, and bank account details
Upload all required documents in specified format (JPG/PDF within size limits)
Verify all details and submit before the deadline (typically October 31 each year)
For any issues contact: pragati@aicte-india.org or helpdesk@nsp.gov.in or call 011-29581118
For renewal each year: login to portal and submit renewal form with Promotion Certificate certified by Head of Institution
Track application and merit list status on the AICTE Pragati-Saksham portal
